annotations.title: Size a student housing loan by the bed

description: The studenthousing.loans by-the-bed loan sizer: from beds, rent per bed, months collected, vacancy, expenses, reserves, value and your own interest rate, returns net operating income and the loan allowed by max LTV, min DSCR and an optional debt yield, the maximum loan (the smallest), which test binds, annual debt service and loan per bed. Presets are Freddie Mac's published student housing LTV/DSCR tiers.

amortization_years.description: Amortization in years, 0 = interest only. Default 30 (0 with the full-IO preset).

interest_rate_pct.description: Your own quoted interest rate, percent, e.g. 6.25.

max_ltv_pct.description: Max loan-to-value, percent. Overrides the preset.

min_debt_yield_pct.description: Minimum debt yield, percent. Omit or 0 to skip the test.

min_dscr.description: Minimum debt service coverage, e.g. 1.25. Overrides the preset.

months_collected.description: Months of rent collected a year: 12 on 12-month leases, less if summer is empty.

opex_per_bed_year.description: Operating expenses per bed per year (taxes, insurance, payroll, utilities, turnover), dollars.

other_income_per_bed_month.description: Other income per bed per month (parking, fees, utility bill-backs), dollars.

preset.description: Freddie Mac student housing tier: freddie_5_7yr = 75% LTV / 1.30x; freddie_over_7yr = 80% / 1.30x; freddie_full_io_5_7yr = 65% / 1.30x, interest only.

rent_per_bed_month.description: Rent per bed per month, dollars.

reserves_per_bed_year.description: Replacement reserves per bed per year, dollars. Default 150, Freddie Mac's stated minimum per bed.

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy, concessions and bad debt, percent of rent. Default 5, Fannie Mae's by-the-bed floor with a T-12 (10 without one).

value.description: Property value or purchase price, dollars.
